title: Operations Manager - West Midlands Sort Centre
description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M), led by deep-tech investors Plural (whose portfolio spans fusion energy and space exploration), Relay is scaling faster than 99.98% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~110 people , more than half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation The Opportunity You will report to the Site Manager/Head of Site and will run shifts at one of our Hybrid Sort Centres (HSCs), leading 50–100+ operatives through high-volume, time-pressured sortation where minutes matter and small deviations cascade into missed deadlines. Each of our HSCs handle over 40 million parcels annually, with our largest site measuring more than 300,000 sq ft. You will also be accountable for whether the site is measurably better in a month than it is today for each of our key metrics. You are on the floor for your shift, every shift. This is not a project role with occasional site visits and it is not a desk job, the forward work happens along with running the operation. Who will thrive in this role Deliver shift plan end to end people deployment, throughput, quality standards, and health & safety compliance Lead, develop, and performance-manage a frontline team of 50–100+ operatives Build the mechanisms that hold the operation together. Build controls, cadences, metrics, SOPs, change management and own their adoption, not only their design Plan ahead for future shifts; labour, training, and the risks you can see coming before they land Own the end-of-shift handover; what happened, what is at risk, what the next shift needs to know Stay decisive through volume peaks, outages, and labour gaps. Triage, solve the problem at hand quickly, contain the impact, restore flow Present and write clearly whether briefs, escalations, handovers or post-incident reviews. Decisions here get made based off what you wrote Implement changes into a live operation such as introducing robotics, launching new sortation tech or onboarding new clients. We are changing the operations constantly which means you’ll roll change out mid flight and bring your team along the journey. Who you are Scaled something from zero : a site, a market, a process or a program. Managed a physical operation : quick commerce, grocery, e-commerce fulfillment, last mile, 3PL, food production, airport ground handling, rail. Anywhere with a hard cut off and people on the floor. Communicate in both directions and have strong people management skills : you can brief 80 operatives at shift start and take a problem to senior leadership the same day. Built a mechanism that held : a control, a cadence, a metric, a document standard. Something you authored that changed how frontline teams worked. Own numbers rather than report them : you can name a metric you created or redefined, explain why the previous one was wrong, and say what changed afterwards. Understand frontline work : one of these must be true: you have personally led frontline teams; you have worked embedded in and around a frontline population day to day, without the reporting line; or you have been accountable for outcomes delivered by frontline people you did not employ. You do not need to have worked in parcels, fulfilment

We're looking for an Engagement Manager to own adoption across a portfolio of mid-market corporate clients and help their in-house legal teams fundamentally change the way they work. You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption programme at Legora, helping clients realise measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work. What You'll Do You'll lead the post-sale customer experience, owning onboarding, adoption and long-term value realisation for a portfolio of 15 – 20 mid-market corporates. Execute against that playbook, sequencing initiatives from initial rollout to function- and enterprise-wide scaled adoption and adapting as the client's needs and Legora's capabilities evolve. Run those programmes in parallel across the full portfolio, holding the plan, the milestones and the risks for every account and knowing at any moment which ones need your attention this week. Act as a strategic adviser who deeply understands in-house legal priorities — cost, cycle time, risk and doing more without adding headcount — surfaces high-impact opportunities and guides teams towards maximum value from Legora. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a manage-from-the-sidelines one. You’ll work directly with the CEO, lead SDRs and Account Executives, improve how pipeline is created and converted, and bring greater clarity to forecasting, performance and where the next growth opportunities sit. The opportunity Stora has grown quickly, but the next stage requires more than simply doing more of what worked before. The Head of Sales will be expected to answer questions like: Where should the team focus its time and why? How does outbound become consistently productive? Where are deals getting stuck? How should SDRs and AEs be coached and developed? Which segments and markets represent the strongest opportunities? What needs to change in the sales motion as Stora moves upmarket and expands internationally? How does the business build a forecast leadership can genuinely rely on? This is a role with real authority to improve things, alongside accountability for the results. A track record proven by hits like Cleanup (#1 iPhone storage cleaner worldwide), Retake AI (#1 AI face editing app in the US), and Learna AI (the top AI language learning app globally), alongside 50+ other apps across productivity, edtech, wellness, and entertainment, all shaping the future of consumer mobile. Since launching in 2020 with a small team in Istanbul, we've grown into a 300+ person global team. With over 400 million downloads and a worldwide footprint, we're already one of the fastest-growing consumer tech companies in Europe, and join us in our next big chapter. POSITION As our Corporate FP&A Analyst - Planning, you will report directly to the Director of FP&A and sit at the ultimate strategic clearinghouse of our finance function. As our portfolio scales globally, we are building a lean, world-class decision-support function from the ground up to evaluate complex strategic options, portfolio expansions, and capital deployment choices. You will sit at the corporate level, owning the master consolidation, corporate budget, and the underlying logic for individual app-level P&Ls. This is an AI-first, digital-native finance team. We communicate via active Slack channels, build out our operational blueprints and context sharing inside Notion, and run collaboration entirely through Google Workspace. Tactical Liquidity Control: Active management of short-term cash mechanics, specifically building 13-week rolling cash flow forecasts . Unsere Maxime lautet: Immer ein bisschen mehr tun als der Wettbewerb, Dinge ausprobieren, ausgetretene Pfade vermeiden und die Bodenhaftung nicht verlieren. Alles, was Sie zum Arbeiten benötigen: Klimatisierte Büros, kostenlose Parkplätze sowie eine moderne Arbeitsplatzumgebung. Durch einen Mitarbeiterrabatt in unserem Fabrikverkauf sowie im Tamaris Onlineshop füllt sich der Schuhschrank wie von alleine. Niemand tritt gerne auf der Stelle: Durch Schulungen und Seminare fördern wir Ihre persönliche und fachliche Weiterbildung, denn Ihr Karriereweg ist keine Einbahnstraße. Fit und entspannt im Alltag: Durch verschiedene kostenlose Betriebssportgruppen, eine Kooperation mit lokalen Fitnessstudios sowie mit dem Anbieter sportnavi.de. Wir feiern Erfolg und Gemeinschaft: Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Team-Events und Firmenfeiern sind ein fester Bestandteil unserer Unternehmenskultur. Was Sie ausmacht: Schuhgröße 37, Fußlänge 231 – 236 mm, durchschnittliche Fuß- und Wadenform Großes Interesse an Mode und Schuhen sowie ein starkes Bewusstsein für die Qualität von Materialien und deren Verarbeitung Hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit gepaart mit guten Englischkenntnissen in Wort und Schrift Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung wünschenswert; gerne auch Quereinsteiger Hohes Engagement Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen Sie sind ein verantwortungsbewusster und äußerst engagierter Teamplayer und schätzen die konstruktive Zusammenarbeit? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre aussagefähigen Bewerbungsunterlagen. title: Head of Operations (m/w/d) | Health & Beauty Scale-up
description: MY HEALTH & BEAUTY ist Deutschlands erstes Health&Beauty-Startup mit dem Ziel, hochwertige ästhetische Medizin und moderne Longevity-Anwendungen für eine breite Zielgruppe zugänglich, unkompliziert, bezahlbar und flächendeckend verfügbar zu machen. Der Markt für ästhetische Medizin und Longevity wächst sehr stark. Deine Mission Für die nächste Phase unseres Wachstums suchen wir einen Head of Operations, der die operative Entwicklung unserer HEALTH&BEAUTY Lounges verantwortet und gemeinsam mit uns die Grundlage für die nächsten 10, 20 und oder 100 Standorte schafft. Du entwickelst Mitarbeiter und Führungskräfte weiter, gibst klares Feedback und schaffst eindeutige Verantwortlichkeiten. Du erkennst Leistungsträger frühzeitig und entwickelst sie weiter. Genauso konsequent gehst du mit Underperformance um. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Recruiting Team dafür, dass unsere Standorte jederzeit mit den richtigen Menschen besetzt sind und wir auch bei starkem Wachstum oder Ausfällen unsere personellen Standards halten.
